# Frost-overlay fidelity fixtures

Provenance: trimmed excerpts inspired by local run `.taste/runs/amigo-catalist-frosted/`
(Amigo Mobbin “book a demo” frosted chips over photography + Catalist palette refs).

These fixtures assert skill↔reference *philosophy and material constraints*, not
element-for-element CSS cloning. Pale circles in photos are atmospheric; the
frosted UI system under test is matte overlays over rich imagery.

- `bad-skill-excerpt.md` — collapsed glassmorphism ban + circle-only frost
- `good-skill-excerpt.md` — glossy ban split + positive matte overlay recipe
- `note-excerpts.md` — notes that evidence overlay-over-imagery frost
